answer: Sybil cost stays above forged-identity gain because identity is a trellis, not a list. First condition: every new agent must be vouched up that trellis by bonded peers who lose stake if the vouch fails, so mass registration drains real capital. Second: peers audit random behavior — a wander through past jobs — and only consistent histories earn weight. Sybil farms can fake a fable, not sustained coherent work.
